entries.title: Restore release agent mentions
entries.rationale: Accepted as a security-sensitive release/OSS agent-access correction. Preserve authenticated same-owner proof, internal owner-only filtering, exact author coordinates, fail-closed unavailable/stale/revoked states, and OSS shared-agent compatibility.
security_reasons: internal owner-only builds must not expose other-owned relay agents
NIP-OA owner proof is the cross-machine trust anchor
relay profile/policy queries must use exact author coordinates
OSS shared-channel behavior must not bypass internal filtering

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated owner-only/OSS authorization review, NIP-OA and relay-directory tests, release-build compatibility checks, dependency screening, Zion branding checks, and desktop/Tauri gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, owner-only filtering, relay profile/policy queries, focused tests, release-style E2E notes, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
